patch_description:
The current program deviates from the proven architecture that achieved 0.91 combined score. It replaced the linear chain CZ entanglement with a star topology using CRY gates, which led to:
- 4% drop in validation accuracy (0.93→0.89)
- 2% drop in test accuracy (0.90→0.87)
- Worse generalization gap (0.02→0.05)
- 48% more parameters (50→74) with worse performance

This change restores the core structure that worked well:
1. Reinstate the linear chain CZ entanglement (proven effective, low-depth)
2. Keep the parametrized CRZ reverse chain (was part of prior 0.91 solution)
3. Add strategic X-axis rotation (CRX) at the circuit core (qubits 2-4 region) to introduce localized axis variation and test whether X-axis entanglement boosts expressivity in the middle layers

The hybrid CRZ/CRX reverse chain maintains parameter efficiency while testing a new degree of freedom. This returns to the proven foundation while incorporating targeted improvements.
